svg.text: Contents checklist, bill of materials, construction & cutting list
Cardboard prototype P1-P5 + client brief and reference photos R1-R6
SHEET 9 - CONTENTS CHECKLIST, BILL OF MATERIALS, CONSTRUCTION & CUTTING LIST
CONTENTS CHECKLIST - 64 tips (32 pairs), 5 cables, 14 accessories: where each item lives
Totals: 17 pairs x 10 cm (34 tips) on panels 1 + 2; 15 pairs x 5 cm (30 tips) on panels 3 + 4; 32 pairs / 64 tips.
Accessories: 6 caps + 4 keys -> panel 2 pocket A; 3 connectors + grip patch -> pocket B; 5 cables -> panel 4 (back wall) pocket.
Outer shell, full-grain leather 1.2-1.4 mm (or PU 1.0-1.2), tan
Lining 0.6 mm, tan (back-wall lining = panel 4, sheet 7)
Board 1.0 mm: back wall, front panel
Page face plies 1.0 mm (slits die-cut) + back plies 0.6 mm
Strap, leather 1.4 mm, dark brown, 2 ply
Cable pocket body + flap, 0.8 mm leather
Small pocket bodies + flaps, 0.8 mm leather
1. Cut shell, lining, board, pages and pockets (sheets 2, 4-8). Die-cut the elastic slits in the three page face plies and in the
back-wall lining (sheets 4-7 at 1:1). Emboss the logo on the top flap while flat.
2. Make the pockets on the face plies (panel 2: A, B; back-wall lining: cable pocket). Set the pocket snaps.
3. Thread the elastics in and out of the slits, loop by loop; bar-tack each slit, stitch the ends down. Print / stamp the size labels.
4. Laminate each page: face ply + 0.8 board + back ply; edge-stitch 0.3, leaving the 1.5 hinge tab single-ply.
5. Stitch the strap to the outer shell (back wall + top gusset + top flap). Stitch the buckle piece and keeper to the front panel.
6. Set the side-flap studs and the front-panel sockets. Laminate lining to shell with board in the back wall and front panel.
7. Stitch the page hinge tabs through the bottom gusset in order P3, P2, P1 (sheet 8, detail C). Turn / bind all edges; edge-stitch 0.3.
8. Dry-fold, check the side-flap snaps and the strap length through the buckle. Load the set; the closed case must not press on the 10 mm tips.
Cut pieces +/- 0.1 cm; slit positions +/- 0.05 cm (the 0.6 loop must still take two 2 mm tips); snap centres +/- 0.15 cm; hinge seams +/- 0.1 cm.
MEASUREMENT RECORD - what each prototype / reference photo contributed
Top flap 5.0, top gusset 6.5, back 21.0 x 13.0, bottom gusset 6.0, front 12.7; side gusset 5.7, side flap 8.0, snaps
Loop widths 0.6-2.2 (= 6-22 mm), 0.5 between loops, 1.0 end margins, 1.5 above the points
Trifold clutch, wrap strap 3.0 with buckle, keeper; logo on flap; R 1.0 corners; contrast edge stitch
Pages sewn into the bottom gusset, not removable; side flaps tuck inside
1.5 elastic threaded in / out of the panel per pair; size labels above tips; snap pockets on panel 2 and the back wall
Front > P1 > P2 > P3 > back wall; back wall = panel 4 with cable pocket; 2 small pockets on panel 2; adjustable strap
HARDWARE SIZE ASSUMPTIONS (confirm against the real set - Q5)
